behavior.text: Heading direction: E-PG ring neurons carry the fly's internal compass — an activity bump that tracks heading around the ellipsoid body, feeding ring neurons, protocerebral-bridge intrinsics, and fan-shaped-body steering outputs.
behavior.basis: E-PG as the heading-direction ring is textbook Drosophila (Seelig & Jayaraman 2015; Green et al 2017); edges below are the resolved API walk, stated as measured wiring

fly_narration: North lives here — hold it, turn it.
honest_note: Hop-1 takes the top-6 specific classes by synapse weight; duplicated ancestor/child tiers are represented by their most specific member; generic ontology buckets skipped (documented in build_compass.py). E-PG->E-PG itself (tw=14614) is REAL recurrence, skipped per the no-self-loop convention, recorded here not hidden. Real below-cutoff partners worth noting (same pattern as pIP10 in mating / giant fiber in looming): Delta7 'adult intrinsic protocerebral bridge 18 glomeruli-delta7 neuron' (tw=30232, the ring's global inhibition), PEN 'adult protocerebral bridge 1 glomerulus-ellipsoid body tile-nodulus 1 neuron' (tw=26851), PFN 'adult protocerebral bridge 1 glomerulus-fan-shaped body-nodulus neuron' (tw=12306), PFL 'adult protocerebral bridge 1 glomerulus-fan-shaped body-lateral accessory lobe neuron' (tw=12066), 'adult ellipsoid body R-neuron' (tw=18246). CIRCUIT VS DYNAMICS: every edge is REAL measured wiring of E-PG's downstream chain. The RING-ATTRACTOR DYNAMICS — how the activity bump moves, holds, and updates heading — are the genuinely unmapped frontier; no API holds them and this graph models none of them.
